title: Add Copilot instruction baseline
body:
Establishes the Copilot instruction foundation for this fully AI-authored repo. Adds a general instruction file and a Markdown-specific one enforcing conciseness across all `.md` output.

## Changes

- **`.github/copilot-instructions.md`** — Base instructions: convention-following principle, and output guidelines for markdown files and comments/suggestions.
- **`.github/instructions/markdown.instructions.md`** — Scoped via `applyTo: "**/*.md"`. Prohibits filler phrases, favors bullets over prose, restricts decorative structure.
